title: Policy
description: What agents may do in a project. Opt-in. A policy can state a rule (advisory, added to every agent's project context), enforce a guard (a Claude Code hook that refuses tool calls), and change roles or flows. Strings in rule, overrides and permissions may use {{config.<key>}}.

config.description: Defaults, overridable per project: policies: { <id>: { config: {...} } }.

rule.description: One or two sentences added under 'Project rules' in every agent's context.

guard.description: A hook script shipped next to this file. The build copies it to .claude/hooks/ai-<id>.mjs, writes the config next to it as ai-<id>.json, and registers it in the managed settings file.

script.description: File name, relative to this policy's directory.

overrides.description: Applied to other modules while the policy is enabled, like a project's overrides.

permissions.description: Entries added to permissions.allow in the managed settings file.
